title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: Every final decision of a panel is published. Draft decisions are not final. A document called Note Aspen is published, but its status is not given. Decision Birch is final. The passage does not say that only final documents are published.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
